4h.text: AI chip packaging is jammed. Intel's answer: EMIB-T.  How it differs from TSMC's CoWoS: CoWoS-L embeds small silicon bridges in an interposer. Intel's EMIB skips the interposer and embeds the bridges in the substrate.  The T is TSV: power goes straight up through the bridge.

8h.text: AI chip packaging is jammed. Intel's answer: EMIB-T.  How it differs from TSMC's CoWoS: CoWoS-L embeds small silicon bridges in an interposer. Intel's EMIB skips the interposer and embeds the bridges in the substrate.  The T is TSV: power goes straight up through the bridge.
